profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Assurant Labs
profile.summary:
A passionate and driven Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience in designing, building, and maintaining innovative, high-performance iOS and Android native mobile applications, as well as cross-platform solutions. I am deeply interested in iOS development and am committed to delivering exceptional software experiences.

8+ years of experience in full-stack software development.
Expertise in developing native iOS apps using Swift5, and a strong passion for iOS development.
Experience in developing native Android apps using Java/Kotlin and cross-platform apps using React Native (TypeScript).
Skilled in developing RESTful APIs and Microservices using Node.js, Spring Boot, MuleSoft, and Oracle OIC.
Experience working on multiple projects, leading engineering meetings, and mentoring junior developers.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, Git, and software design principles, including clean code, SOLID, and TDD.
Developed and maintained software solutions for various industries, collaborating with both local and offshore teams.
Looking forward to continuing my growth in iOS and software development roles, contributing to impactful projects, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in mobile technology.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Parlin, New Jersey, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain iOS applications using Swift and Android applications using Java/Kotlin.
- Design, build, and maintain React Native applications using TypeScript.
- Architect and develop web pages, RESTful APIs, and Microservices using Node.js and TypeScript.
- Lead engineering meetings and drive technical discussions to align on project goals.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including offshore teams, to deliver common projects and services.
- Deploy services and SDKs, ensuring smooth and reliable releases.
- Identify, address, and troubleshoot bugs and issues across multiple projects.
- Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to mid-level developers.
- Participate in Agile/SCRUM workflows, collaborating with team members to define and implement new features.
- Write clean, efficient, and high-quality code, ensuring features are delivered on time.
- Implement smooth animations and transitions to enhance user experience in mobile applications.
- Perform code reviews and security reviews to ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
- Maintain version control using GIT, implementing branching strategies and feature branches effectively.
positions.insights: Skills: Core Java · Computer Security · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · SQL · Java · Android Development · XML · AWS Lambda · Software Development · Xcode · Swift · TypeScript · React.js · Web Services API · iOS Development · Node.js · React Native · Android · Git · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Developing and maintaining iOS applications (Swift 5) and Android applications in (Java, Kotlin, Jetpack Components) to communicate with ASI Audio 3DME devices and headphone via Bluetooth or USB.
•	Working extensively with Storyboard, Core Data, Multi-Threading with GCD, UserDefaults, UIAlertController, Delegates/Protocols, Extensions, JSON and Cocoapods, etc.
•	Creating TestFlights and deploying and maintaining iOS apps on App Store Connect.
•	Developing and maintaining various Android (Java, Kotlin, Jetpack components) mobile applications, with SPEAR® and Conversational AI using Natural Language Understanding and Text-to-Speech.
•	Deployed Android applications to Google Play Store and Amazon App Store.
•	Integrated Firebase for analytics and crashlytics.
•	Closely working with clients on their requirements and guiding solution implementation.
•	End to end native application development experience for product-based companies.
•	Following Agile Methodology for Project Management.
•	Applying clean code architecture, SOLID principles, Test-driven design (TDD), and other software design principles to produce reliable high-quality software products.
•	Expertise in using Git commands and following standard Git flow.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Android Development · Web Services API · iOS Development · Git

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	BIAS Corporation is an Oracle Specialized Platinum Partner, Certified Oracle Reseller, Systems Integrator of the entire Oracle line of products and Solution Provider. 
•	Worked on Oracle SOA, Business rules and created web services based on client requirement.
•	Designed and developed APIs using Spring boot, .NET, MuleSoft, and Oracle OIC.
•	Install, upgrade and migration experience in Oracle WebCenter. 
•	Very good knowledge and experience in designing computer architecture, server, cluster, load balancer, database, web services.
•	Designed and developed web application for the client where users can email and chat with each other. Also created Web services using spring boot to interact with oracle database. Designed architecture and provided end to end solution to the client.
•	Maintained the windows application created for the client in past.
•	Worked on ADF application which is connected with Oracle IoT to display different condition like earthquake, traffic and more based on sensor information.
•	Worked on Android application to get real time data from IoT and shows sensors and the condition on Maps and Chart.
•	Worked on iOS application to provide inventory and return product information for the client. I also provided Test Flight support to clients for testing and feedback.
•	Worked on integrating APNS and Network Connectivity. 
•	Experienced in adding Animation for smooth transitioning between UI Views for better user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Android Development · Web Services API · iOS Development · Git

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
•	Created “Earthquake News” Android application for phone and tablet. 
•	Implemented different approaches (like AsyncLoader class and HttpURLConnection) to fetch earthquake news information from 3rd party REST API.
•	Used 3rd party libraries like Recycler View, Card View, Async-http, Recycler view animators, Glide, Butterknife, Expandable layout, Android animations etc.
•	Used of Proguard, knowledge of Espresso, Junit test.
•	Used Floating Action Buttons(FAB) and Navigation Drawer in Coordinator Layout
•	Implemented google ads and firebase libraries for Banner ads at the bottom of all fragments.
•	Created different fragments for Recycler View and for general knowledge and facts about Earthquake and Tsunami.
•	Parsed JSON response to recycler view and user can get detail information for each earthquake by clicking on list item, which will jump to USGS page.
•	Programmed the way, so tablet can have more cards in a row.
•	User can share data by tapping “Share” button on cards.
•	User can share application and jump to Play Store market to rate and update application.
•	User is also able to find recent earthquakes order by “Most Recent” or by “Magnitude”.
•	User can set minimum magnitude for the earthquake list.
•	It shows Tsunami Alert and Impact level.
•	Launched in many languages like English, Spanish, Dutch etc.
•	Hosting project to “Bitbucket” using “Git” version control system.
•	App can be downloaded from
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.handm.dhruval.earthquakenews
